achievement_completion.seo_title: IRON NEST Achievement Completion Checker | IronNestPedia
achievement_completion.seo_description: Enter a SteamID64 or profile URL to find missing IRON NEST achievements, sorted by live global completion rate from rarest upward.
achievement_completion.intro: Check all 33 achievements for one Steam profile. Missing achievements are listed first, from the lowest global completion rate upward.
achievement_completion.input_help: The profile's Game details must be Public. Your input is sent to IronNestPedia's serverless endpoint and Steam for this lookup; this site does not store it.
achievement_completion.invalid_input: Enter a 17-digit SteamID64 or a steamcommunity.com profile URL.
achievement_completion.profile_not_found: Steam could not resolve that profile URL. Check the address and try again.
achievement_completion.profile_unavailable: Steam could not return this profile's achievements. The most common cause is private Game details. Set Steam Profile → Privacy Settings → Game details to Public, then try again. If it is already public, wait a moment and retry.
achievement_completion.steam_unavailable: Steam did not return usable achievement data. Try again in a moment.
achievement_completion.service_not_configured: The lookup service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
achievement_completion.data_mismatch: Steam returned an achievement set that could not be matched safely. No partial result is shown.
achievement_completion.unknown_error: The lookup could not be completed. Try again in a moment.
achievement_completion.all_unlocked: All 33 achievements are unlocked on this profile.
achievement_completion.no_result: Run a lookup to see this profile's missing achievements.
achievement_completion.data_text: Player unlock status and global completion rates are requested live from Steam. Names and descriptions use IronNestPedia's verified Version 4 achievement data.
tutorial: Open the Steam profile and copy its URL, or copy the account's 17-digit SteamID64.
In Steam Profile → Privacy Settings, set Game details to Public.
Paste the ID or URL above and select Check achievements.

faq.question: Which profile links are accepted?
faq.answer: The checker accepts 17-digit SteamID64 values, numeric /profiles/ links, and custom /id/ profile links on steamcommunity.com.

faq.question: Why does a public profile still fail?
faq.answer: Steam has a separate privacy setting for Game details. The main profile can be public while achievement data remains private.

faq.question: Are the rarity percentages historical?
faq.answer: No. The checker requests a current global completion snapshot from Steam each time you run it; it does not build a trend history.
